change.no_price: This plan has no {period} price in {currency}. Add one on the Plans page, or choose another currency or period.

plans.title: Plans
plans.text: Your own plans for your clients, built on ours: your name, your prices, and the modules you choose to include.
plans.mode_wholesale: You pay us a wholesale price for each client and bill your clients yourself, at the prices you set here.
plans.mode_revenue_share: We bill your clients at these prices under your brand, and you earn {share}% of each invoice before tax.
plans.mode_direct: We bill your clients directly at these prices.
plans.empty_title: No plans of your own yet
plans.empty_text: Make a plan with your own name and prices, then put clients on it from the Clients page.
plans.margin: You keep {amount} per client each month (our price: {cost}).
plans.loss: You lose {amount} per client each month: our price is {cost}.
plans.cost_per_client: Our price: {amount} per client per month.
plans.cost_per_seat: Our price: {amount} per staff user per month.
plans.all_modules: Every module of the base plan
plans.archive_text_one: New clients can no longer be put on it. The {count} client on it keeps it.
plans.archive_text_other: New clients can no longer be put on it. The {count} clients on it keep it.

dialog.text: Clients see this name and these prices. They can never get more modules than the plan underneath.
dialog.name_required: Give the plan an English name.
dialog.locked_one: {count} client is on this plan, so its base plan and modules are fixed. Make a new plan to change them.
dialog.locked_other: {count} clients are on this plan, so its base plan and modules are fixed. Make a new plan to change them.
dialog.base_hint: Our plan underneath: it decides the most modules and the limits.
dialog.all_modules_hint: Everything {plan} has, including modules added later.
dialog.prices_hint: At least one. Clients are billed in the currency and period you choose for them.

partner.title: Billing
partner.text_wholesale: What we invoice you each month for your clients. You bill your clients yourself.
partner.text_revenue_share: What your clients were invoiced under your brand, and your share of it.

cards.we_bill_you_hint: Invoiced in {currency} on the 1st of each month.
cards.payable_hint: Your {share}% of invoices clients have paid.
cards.pending_hint: Your share of invoices not paid yet.

partner.empty_text: Invoices are issued on the 1st of each month.

client.title: Billing
client.text: Your plan and the invoices for it.
client.next_first: At the start of next month
client.empty_text: Your first invoice arrives at the start of the month after you joined.

self.text: Your plan, what it costs, and paying for it online.
self.free_line: You are on the free plan. Upgrade any time; your data comes with you.
self.trial_line_one: Free trial: {days} day left (until {date}). Choose a plan to keep its features.
self.trial_line_other: Free trial: {days} days left (until {date}). Choose a plan to keep its features.
self.paid_line: Paid until {date}. The renewal invoice arrives a few days before.
self.moves_line: You move to the free plan on {date}. Until then everything stays as it is.
self.past_due_line: An invoice is overdue. Please pay it by {date} to keep full access.
self.read_only_line: Read-only until the overdue invoice is paid. You can still view and export everything; nothing is deleted.
self.pay_or_free: Or move to the free plan instead.
self.to_free_text_now: Features the free plan does not have switch off now. Their data is kept and comes back if you upgrade again.
self.to_free_text_later: You keep your current plan until the paid period ends, then move to the free plan. You can change your mind until then.
self.to_free_text_invoice: Unpaid invoices are cancelled, and the workspace works again at once. Features the free plan does not have switch off; their data is kept.
self.trial_text: No payment needed. At the end you go back to the free plan unless you choose to buy. One trial per person.
self.unverified: Confirm your email or phone to buy or start a trial.
self.no_online: Online payment is not available for your country or currency yet. Please contact support to pay.
self.test_mode: Test mode: payments go to the SSLCommerz sandbox and no real money is taken.
self.pending_payment: A payment you started is still open.
self.change_later: You can change plans when your paid period ends on {date}.
self.empty_text: Receipts for what you buy and invoices for renewals appear here.

checkout.title: Buy {plan}
checkout.text: Check the details, then pay on the secure page of our payment partner (bKash, Nagad, cards).
checkout.leave_note: You will leave this page for the payment page and come back here afterwards.

payment.title: Payment
payment.pending_text: This usually takes a few seconds. You can close this page; we will email you the receipt.
payment.pending_slow: It is taking longer than usual. If you did not finish on the payment page, you can go back to it.
payment.failed_title: The payment did not go through
payment.failed_text: No money was taken by us. You can try again with the same or another method.
payment.cancelled_text: You cancelled on the payment page. Nothing was charged.
payment.expired_text: The payment page was not completed in time. Nothing was charged; you can start again.
payment.review_text: We received a payment that needs a quick check before it counts. We will email you; you do not need to pay again.
payment.refund_text: This invoice was already paid, so this payment will be refunded.
